baseline: authoritative source-free F0; ABS+DELTA+RATIO; original Patient Z; ZDELTA absent

screening.assignment: sorted outer-FIT IDs, RNG(fold_seed) permutation, array_split3
screening.checkpoint_selection_split: remaining FIT IDs, RNG(fold_seed+10000+h) permutation; first ceil(20%) for checkpoint selection
screening.cell_seed: fold_seed+10000+h; identical for full and all 21 independent deletion retrains
screening.preprocessing: original 88D Patient Z then original imputer/scaler; nested imputer/scaler fit ONLY inner training IDs; never screening or Development IDs
screening.ranking: descending AUROC gain, descending AP gain, ascending authoritative group index
screening.joint_effect: not assumed from independent eligibility; evaluated only by predeclared B3
screening.no_eligible: B3 and B4 alias B1; no distinct training effect fabricated

compact: multiplicity-aware original-LN88 statistics; folded Linear(k,96), GELU, Dropout0.15, Linear(96,1); no trainable LN affine; removed coordinates treated as original zeros
initialization: scratch original SourceA0(seed).network constructed first; exact fold of original seeded initialization, never trained F0 warm start

training.selection: own selection-patient Macro-F1, EZ-F1, earlier epoch
training.threshold: original NEZ grid0.005 with original ties

stop: no rescue search, no global subset from Development, no outer TEST, no extra seeds
publish: source, hashes, anonymous aggregates only; identities, features, scores and checkpoints private
